name: A Torn Journal Page
summary: In Stormwind, A Torn Journal Page links an old crate to Stalvan Mistmantle's past. Its worn script points toward records kept in Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: A Clue in the Canals
sections.body: A Torn Journal Page lies in a sealed storage crate beside Stormwind City's canals. Old books, family heirlooms, and a ceramic vase surround the worn fragment among forgotten personal effects. Its distinct handwriting points to Stalvan Mistmantle's past, though the page is damaged and hard to read. Who in the kingdom might recognize the hand that wrote it?

sections.title: Tracing the Mistmantle Trail
sections.body: Marshal Haggard lives in Elwynn Forest, far from Stormwind. The aging officer's eyesight is failing, but he remembers the distinctive handwriting from an earlier chapter in the tragic Mistmantle saga. The weathered page must be brought to someone familiar with the kingdom's older records.

faq.q: Where is the torn journal page found?
aliases: where to find torn journal page
faq.answer: A Torn Journal Page lies inside a sealed storage crate beside Stormwind City's canals, beneath forgotten household items, hunting trophies, and an old ceramic vase.

faq.q: Whose journal did this page come from?
faq.answer: The page came from Stalvan Mistmantle's personal writings. He was a former tutor whose dark past and sudden disappearance drew investigation across Duskwood and Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Who can read the handwriting on the torn page?
aliases: who do i take the torn page to
who reads the torn journal page
faq.answer: Marshal Haggard can recognize the handwriting. The elderly, nearly blind retired officer lives near the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest and remembers seeing it before his eyesight failed.

faq.q: Why does finding the page matter to Duskwood?
faq.answer: Finding the page matters because the Town Council of Darkshire is piecing together Stalvan Mistmantle's history to uncover the truth behind unsettling occurrences and long-buried crimes tied to him.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can see how unresolved crimes and forgotten records in Stormwind and Elwynn reach outward to haunt Duskwood's struggling frontier.
